_comment: Example incident log for incident_backtest against the todomvc suite. Replace with your real postmortems: id, title, the requirement ids the incident touched, optional named journeys, a one-line symptom, and a severity weight.

incidents.title: Items-left count froze at 0 after adding items
incidents.symptom: the items left count did not reflect newly added items

incidents.title: Clear completed button never appeared after completing a todo
incidents.symptom: completing an item did not reveal the clear completed control

incidents.title: Toggle-all left some items active
incidents.symptom: marking all complete still left items counted as active

incidents.title: Todos vanished after a page reload
incidents.symptom: items were not persisted to local storage across a browser reload
